text:
Priya Nair: Quick sync — finalizing image publish workflow for AWS/GCP/Azure. Main outstanding: localized listing copy + signed image checksums. Timeline: aim to go live next Tue. Who's on tasks?

Ethan Wu: I'll own AMI/GCP image creation + signing. Plan: bake AMIs in CI, sign with CI key, publish manifest with checksum. Need publisher IDs and any region-blocking notes.

Helen Brooks: I'll take localized marketing copy and screenshots. Need guidance on character limits per marketplace and translations for FR/DE/ES. Also confirming legal approved phrases.

Carlos Ruiz: I'm owning partner ops handoff. I'll reach out to AWS listing team and Azure publisher ops to validate artifacts. Have a contact for GCP marketplace listings (gcp-pub@partner.cloud).

LegalBot: Reminder: include privacy & telemetry blurb and link to hosted-data-processing statement. EU data residency must be explicit if we advertise eu-west1 availability.

Priya Nair: Ethan — can you add a manifest sample here? We'll run it through the validation script.

Ethan Wu: sample manifest below — includes signed_sha256 and regional image ids.

Ethan Wu: ```json
{
  "product": "redwood-inference",
  "version": "2024-03-12",
  "signed_sha256": "7c9f2a2d3b1e4f6a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1",
  "images": {
    "aws": "ami-0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7",
    "gcp": "redwood-gcp-image-2024-03-12",
    "azure": "redwood-azure-image-v2024-03"
  },
  "regions": ["us-east-1","eu-west-1","asia-southeast1"]
}
```

Helen Brooks: For translations — I'll push strings to Crowdin and link once done. Small ask: do we have region-specific screenshots? If EU, show eu-west console region in screenshot.

Carlos Ruiz: Azure needs publisher ID and offer ID early. I'll request publisher slot and list required legal attachments (logo, support email, terms). ETA 48h.

Priya Nair: marketplace-bot — run manifest lint please and upload to staging bucket.

marketplace-bot: lint results: warnings for missing `support_url` and `privacy_url` fields. Staging bucket created: gs://marketplace-staging/1736667777/ . Upload creds posted to #eng-infra.

Ethan Wu: I'll add support_url and privacy_url. Also will include signed manifest in S3 and GCS with release tag.

LegalBot: I'll review final marketing copy and translations. Note: can't claim "on-prem ready" unless we have private deployment packaging docs linked.

Priya Nair: action items:
- Ethan: upload signed images + final manifest (tomorrow EOD).
- Helen: complete translations + region screenshots (48h).
- Carlos: confirm publisher IDs + attach required assets (48h).
- LegalBot: approve final strings once posted (48h).

Helen Brooks: will post Crowdin link once strings uploaded.

Ethan Wu: uploading manifest to gs://marketplace-staging/1736667777/manifest.json now. Link: https://storage.cloud.example/marketplace-staging/1736667777/manifest.json

Carlos Ruiz: pinged Azure & AWS rep. Azure replied with publisher template and requested logo sizes. Forwarding template to the thread.

Priya Nair: thanks — we'll reconvene here when all artifacts are in staging and schedule a quick QA session with partner reps.

Ethan Wu: FYI — CI created signed manifest and artifact build id: build-20240312-7c9f2a

Priya Nair: perfect, marking this thread for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
